question: Should gateway restart records remain a separate internal forensic ledger, or should they expand the public `openclaw audit` and `audit.list` contract?
rationale: The choice determines public API, event taxonomy, query and filter behavior, schema ownership, retention, and privacy expectations; repository history does not establish that direction conclusively.

options.title: Keep an internal restart ledger
options.body: Retain the dedicated bounded table for gateway forensics without changing the public agent and tool audit API.

options.title: Expand the public audit product
options.body: Add restart event kinds and actions to the existing audit store, Gateway RPC, CLI, protocol, and docs.

options.title: Use ephemeral diagnostics only
options.body: Avoid durable restart history and keep attribution in structured logs or diagnostic events.

recommendation.title: Keep an internal restart ledger
recommendation.body: Retain the dedicated bounded table for gateway forensics without changing the public agent and tool audit API.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent audit product proposal provides the strongest available product-direction signal for deciding whether restart events belong in the public audit contract.
